inventory.visualPurpose: Five DNA repair mechanisms: NHEJ, HR, NER, BER, MMR
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Composite schematic: NHEJ (blunt-end ligation of double-strand break), homologous recombination (sister-chromatid template repair of DSB), nucleotide excision repair (end nuclease cut around bulky lesion), base excision repair (glycosylase removes base, AP site), mismatch repair (new-strand mismatch excision)
